actionAdapters.entry: confirmed business UIView source and UI registration source
actionAdapters.when: View、命名空间、UIGroup 和注册源已经冻结时

actionAdapters.entry: Unity Editor/MCP Prefab creation and serialized reference binding
actionAdapters.when: 用户已确认目标 Prefab 与 Unity 写入范围时
UI注册源和已保存UISettings已冻结；全量scope=all/code/data，单文件sourcePath仅code/data；使用Plan/Execute/编译后Verify

actionAdapters.entry: Nova.UI.OpenUIViewSync<T> / OpenUIViewAsync<T> / OpenUIViewSync(string uiViewName, object userData = null) / OpenUIViewAsync(string uiViewName, object userData = null) / OpenUIViewByAssetSync / OpenUIViewByAssetAsync
actionAdapters.when: 在已授权业务源码接入中按类型、UI表Name或唯一AssetLocation选择配置；所有打开先加载UI注册表，分组、暂停与池化以表为准，缺失或歧义返回-1；旧bool重载仅供迁移且不再覆盖表格
仅适配计划确需更改项目自有 UIComponent 时，按所选 Operation 冻结精确配置资产、原值/目标值、override、保存与读回；不修改包内 canonical Prefab，不把此路由当作新 MCP Action；方向修改须另核对当前宿主实际Player Settings编辑能力，不冒称patch-target支持任意ProjectSettings。

inputs.name: screenAdaptationPlan
inputs.constraint: 按 Docs/Runtime/Modules/UI/UIComponent.md 的屏幕适配与安全区章节由Agent读取并冻结；创建页面必需，更新/Workflow仅布局、画布、方向或安全区分支必需。包含平台方向、设计尺寸/比例和支持范围、缩放/安全区唯一拥有者、有效配置/原目标值、变化刷新与验收；纯数据/事件且布局不变记录沿用及影响范围，不要求用户重复填写可读事实。

allow: generated UI output for this registration
UI Action planned shared UITables, _configs and exact owned stale/counterpart deletions
project-owned UIComponent only through selected nova-project-edit-settings and its exact authorized write scope
deny: manual edits to generated UI output
duplicate root scaling or repeated safe-area insets; physical pixel margins assigned directly to scaled Canvas offsets; implicit global adaptation config changes

requiredFor: ambiguous UIGroup, registration source or asset path
delete, external write, credential use, Git commit or push
confirmation.rule: 确认绑定 viewName、写入集和副作用；输入或范围改变后旧确认失效。 UI导出确认绑定Action PlanId及展示的共享配置、UITables和删除范围。

evidence: 目标源文件和注册源 diff
Unity 创建的 Prefab 与序列化绑定
选定 UI 导出结果
Unity 编译或 Play 证据
布局分支实施前已有 screenAdaptationPlan，实际 UIComponent/CanvasScaler 配置与唯一安全区拥有者符合计划；实际入口的参考/边界比例、安全区、支持方向及重开 Play 布局证据，移动端交付按目标补 Player/设备证据，缺失保持 partial。纯数据/事件且布局不变不扩大验收。
